claims.text: School readiness: teachers are most concerned about language skills and social readiness to separate from parents easily and get along w other children.
claims.quote: Although many parents tend to focus on the child's knowledge of the alphabet, numbers, or drawing skills as evidence of school readiness, teachers are most concerned about the child's language skills and social readiness to separate from parents easily and get along with other children.
claims.locator: 5 and 6 Year Visits, Surveillance of Development

claims.text: School: be alert for ADHD and learning dx; for CSHCN, review the IEP, Section 504 Plan, or any special accommodations.
claims.quote: The health care professional must be alert for diagnoses such as ADHD and learning disorders. For children with special health care needs, it is important for the health care professional to review a copy of the IEP, Section 504 Plan, or any special accommodations.
claims.locator: 5 and 6 Year Visits, Surveillance of Development

claims.text: A 5- or 6-yo (Bright Futures): balances on 1 foot and skips; ties a knot, mature pencil grasp, draws a person w ± 6 body parts, prints some letters and numbers, copies squares and triangles; good articulation, tells a simple story in full sentences, appropriate tenses and pronouns, names ± 4 colors; follows simple directions, listens and attends, dresses and undresses w minimal help.
claims.quote: A 5- or 6-year-old -- Balances on 1 foot, hops, and skips -- Is able to tie a knot, has mature pencil grasp, can draw a person with at least 6 body parts, prints some letters and numbers, and is able to copy squares and triangles -- Has good articulation, tells a simple story using full sentences, uses appropriate tenses and pronouns, can count to 10, and names at least 4 colors -- Follows simple directions, is able to listen and attend, and undresses and dresses with minimal assistance
claims.locator: 5 and 6 Year Visits, Surveillance of Development
